title: Undercut alerts no longer spam one notification per listing
blurb: Holding several copies of one item could trigger the same undercut alert over and over as listings churned, and a competitor relisting a whole set sent one message per item. Undercut alerts now wait a short moment and send a single summary — one item, or "undercut on 4 items: …" — so your inbox, Discord and push notifications get one message instead of a burst.
